# SMARTool example sentences

Source: https://github.com/smartool/data-rus-eng/tree/c20223c008c278c9399d8442f52948fae9c82c1c

Dataset: Data used by SMARTool for English-speaking learners of Russian.
DOI: https://doi.org/10.18710/QNAPNE
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (see SMARTool-LICENSE.txt).

Authors: Radovan Bast, Laura A. Janda, Mikhail Kopotev, Olga Lyashevskaya, James D. McDonald, Tore Nesset, Ekaterina Rakhilina, Svetlana Sokolova, Evgeniia Sudarikova, Francis M. Tyers, Valentina Zhukova, Elizaveta Kibisova.

We selected short bilingual pairs from SMARTool_data_A1/A2/B1/B2.csv, removed stress marks and grouped examples by whole English word. Additional original examples are in source/lesson-example-supplement.txt. The combined offline lookup in source/lesson-examples.json covers all 1,500 bundled headwords with 2–3 examples each.
